subject: Placeholder environment block textures for the lab, facility and prison levels: observation and lab windows, specimen tanks, containment tube, bay, hazard and blast doors, cell bars and gate, lockers, ceiling light, terminal, lab tile wall, yellow stairs, ladder and railing, drain culvert.
visual_approach: Programmer pixel art: hard edges, no antialiasing, steel frames with 1 px highlight / shade bevels and dark seams; cool cyan lab light, amber and red accents; colours from the project's shared palette.

generation_settings.palette: 85 hex constants: the 41 of tools/blocks_placeholder.py followed by 44 in tools/blocks_themes/common.py, all from the project's shared palette (not in the repository)

creative_seed.note: No generator seed. The script uses random.Random with fixed seeds (per-call seeds in the helpers, 101-144 in this theme's tiles) for small details such as grime streaks, bubbles and spots. Every rebuild is identical.

style_inheritance: follows blocks-placeholder.png (same tile size, bevel and seam rules, palette extended from its palette)
